title: Introduce continuity metrics and late-bound log-fork visualizer for token-path decomposition
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds continuity scoring metrics, a log-fork visualizer dashboard, and tuned continuity degradation alerts. Non-breaking.
commits: 4a1e7c: initial continuity metric prototype and collector plumbing
9b2f4d: add continuity score aggregation and per-token path tags
d3c7a1: wire log-fork producer and span-edge annotations
e8f12b: add dashboard json and alert rule for continuity degradation
f4b9c0: tests and docs for continuity collector; CI flake fix

description:
Context and motivation: Production teams have observed long-tail token-path instability where a small fraction of requests deviate mid-invocation (e.g., branch into a different decoding path or trigger a late fallback) causing disproportionate cost and latency outliers. Existing token-cost and latency breakdowns capture endpoints but do not attribute path continuity or the exact point of divergence. This PR introduces a continuity metric (per-invocation and per-token) and a late-bound log-fork visualizer that makes path divergence explicit in traces and dashboards.

What this changes (high level): Implements continuity score computation in telemetry, annotates trace spans with "fork-edge" tags, surfaces a continuity visualizer dashboard that highlights where invocations diverge, and adds a tuned alert rule for "continuity degradation" that suppresses noise for low-volume tenants. Also includes a small SDK surface to expose continuity scores for downstream features (e.g., cohorting, sampling).

Checklist: - [x] Collector and reader implementation (collector.py / reader.go) - [x] Trace annotation and span-edge tagging (log_forker.go) - [x] Continuity visualizer dashboard (dashboards/continuity-visualizer.json) - [x] Alert rule with tenant-volume gating (alerts/continuity-degradation-rule.yml) - [x] Unit tests and replay example (tests/..., examples/...) - [x] Docs and rollout playbook (docs/observability/continuity.md)

Commits summary: 5 commits — prototype, scoring, trace wiring, dashboard + alerts, tests/docs. Key implementation notes: - Continuity score is computed as the normalized "path stability" over a sliding 5-minute window; score components are phase-switch penalty, token-drop penalty, and KV-cache miss multiplier. - To avoid hot-path overhead we added a small LRU for span-edge indices and a feature flag to enable full-edge sampling only for canary tenants. - The log-fork visualizer is implemented as a companion panel to the invocation timeline allowing interactive expansion of forked edges.

Files touched (high level): telemetry/collector + reader (collection, scoring), platform/tracing (span annotation), dashboards (visualizer), alerts (SLO + suppression rule), SDK (continuity API helper), docs/tests/examples.

Review and iteration: Reviewers requested cache to avoid extra lookups (addressed via LRU in reader.go), tooltip and docs for the visualizer (added explanatory panel and docs), and alert damping for low-volume tenants (added tenant-volume gating and changed default threshold to conservative value). CI: initial run had one flaky telemetry test; flake retried automatically per ci/flake_retries.yml and subsequent run passed.

Testing and rollout plan: - Unit tests and synthetic replay (examples/observability/continuity-replay.yaml) included; replay validated continuity score behavior across controlled forks. - Feature flag gated rollout: start with internal canary tenants (10% traffic) for 48 hours, then expand to 50% while monitoring continuity SLO and alert hits. - After 2 weeks of stable signal, enable full-sampling for tiered customers.

Impact and rationale: Provides a missing attribution axis for long-tail cost/latency — rather than just blaming model latency, teams can see when and where invocations fork and quantify the per-token continuity penalty. This enables targeted mitigations (prompt shape changes, caching prefetch) and reduces alert fatigue by correlating divergence to per-invocation causes.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main (merge commit a1b2c3d4). Post-merge actions: monitor continuity SLO dashboards (dashboards/continuity-visualizer) and report early regressions to ENG-2145.
